summary: StaffProfileHistory provides a historical log of profile-related actions for staff members. The screen displays a searchable grid of actions, sections, and changes performed by various users for a given staff member. It includes workflow for loading, refreshing, and displaying profile history, as well as access validation.
purpose: To display and manage the history of profile-related changes and actions for a staff member in a searchable, filterable interface. It enables viewing who performed what action, when, and on which section of the staff profile.

workflows.name: Page Load and Display History
steps: If StaffID is valid, initialize StaffPRHistoryList with session and StaffID
Call FillList to retrieve history data for the staff
Bind the retrieved history list (Data) to the grid for display

workflows.name: Refresh History View
steps: Re-bind the data to the grid

workflows.name: Profile History Search
steps: Invoke stored procedure 'StaffProfileHistorySearch' with StaffID and SessionID
For each entry, populate StaffPRHistory fields including alternate language if enabled
Apply display rules based on FPREConsentObtained and ScreenSection

workflows.name: Profile History Search User Access
steps: Invoke stored procedure 'StaffProfileHistorySearchUserAccess' with StaffID and SessionID

workflows.name: Error/Warning Handling
steps: Error and warning panels are hidden/shown as needed

business_rules: If FPREConsentObtained is false, entries related to Orientation, Certifications, Safety&Security, Infection Control, or Occupational Health are excluded from results.
Support Team details are shown for entries not made by SysAdmin and where ByUserID does not match ByOriginalUserID.
AgencyUser and AgencyUserDetails are dynamically formatted using name and agency information with initials.
validations: StaffID must be a valid integer from the query string.
FPREConsentObtained field is checked before certain sections are displayed.
calculations: AgencyUser is constructed from Agency and user initials.
AgencyUserDetails combines user name, agency, and phone for tooltip display.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines which field variants to use (e.g., ScreenSectionAlt).
FPREConsentObtained determines which sections are shown.
system_behavior: Grid displays historical profile entries for a staff member.
Grid columns include date, section, agency user, action, and change fields.
Buttons allow refreshing, printing, and closing the window.
If no data found, EmptyDataTemplate shown.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for state and DB access.
UI components: GridView, Panels, Buttons, Labels, Literal.
exceptions: Invalid StaffID results in no data displayed.
Database errors or missing session will prevent history from being loaded.
No profile history found: grid displays EmptyDataTemplate.
